faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Research Associate 2 position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Research Associate 2 position at IIT Hyderabad is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Research Associate 2 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Civil Engineering and have expertise in Digital Image Correlation (DIC) for both 2D and 3D applications to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate 2 position is 35 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate 2 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month. Additionally, House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 27% may be applicable if the candidate is eligible.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) applying for the Research Associate 2 position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Associate 2 position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: initial shortlisting based on academic records and achievements, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Research Associate 2 position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIT Hyderabad website or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and required documents are uploaded.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate 2 position at IIT Hyderabad is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official appointment letter.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana. The specific campus address can be found on their official website.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply for the Research Associate 2 position, provided they meet the specified educational qualifications and age criteria.
